name: initial_gain
physics: Initial gain (light-soaking improvement) — efficiency rises, then declines moderately. Most common shape across the heterogeneous dataset.

name: linear_decay
physics: Linear / slow decline — efficiency drops steadily over the 200 h window. Consistent with gradual ion migration or interface degradation.

name: initial_gain_plus_decay
physics: Initial gain with sustained decay — initial light-soaking improvement is followed by a clear degradation phase; rarer than cluster 0.

name: fast_decay
physics: Rapid exponential decay — efficiency collapses within the first few tens of hours; rarest but physically significant catastrophic-failure signature.
